capabilities_done: (1) score::loudness_normalize: BS.1770 integrated target (caller value in NORMALIZE_TARGET_LUFS -70..0) with a true-peak ceiling, measured by score's LoudnessMeter (measure_loudness); PeakPolicy::ReduceGain (peak lands on the ceiling, target missed and reported) or PeakPolicy::Limit (score LookaheadLimiter true_peak at the ceiling, latency compensated, re-measured and corrected up to 6 passes to within 0.05 LU); NormalizeReceipt with input/output integrated + true peak, gain, limited, gain_reduced, passes, limiter latency; no LoudnessStandard enumeration invented (gap STU-FX-147 kept)

(2) score::FadeCurve::SCurve ((1 - cos p pi)/2 in, (1 + cos p pi)/2 out, pair sums to 1) and FadeCurve::Logarithmic (linear in dB over FADE_LOG_RANGE_DB 60, exact 0 at the silent end); Adobe parity UNVERIFIED

(3) score::MixGraph: tracks (StripSpec: TrackSpec rendered by a one-track Session at unity so stack, fades and stack latency are score's; graph applies the track's volume and pan with the session pan laws), buses / aux returns (BusSpec: stereo effect chain, volume, balance pan, output to master or a bus, sends), master (MasterSpec: chain + volume); SendSpec pre/post-fader with a level lane and pan; acyclic routing (cycles, self sends, missing buses, out-of-range levels, non-stereo bus effects refused before rendering); per-input alignment delays A(b) - d_i and graph pre-roll P so every path is sample-aligned (GraphLatency reported); block-partition independent

(4) folio StudioAudioEffectPresetSet / StudioAudioEffectPreset / StudioAudioEffectInstance / StudioAudioPresetParam / StudioAudioPresetKeyframe (STU-FX-039/142/142a/143; schema hsk.studio.style_registry@1), validate_audio_effect_presets + parse_audio_effect_presets; harness audio_batch EffectSpec <-> instance (filter_kind = score identity tags gain/equalizer/dynamics/lookahead_limiter), preset_from_chain, chain_from_preset, save_preset_set / load_preset_set
